entries.task: Build React frontend with 5 widget components
entries.approach: Created modular components with shared WidgetCard, Button, Modal. Used Tailwind for styling with custom theme. Implemented localStorage fallback for all data widgets.

entries.task: Build Express backend with SQLite database
entries.approach: Used better-sqlite3 for synchronous DB operations. Created separate route files for each resource. Implemented validation utilities and custom error classes.

Implemented Crystalline Noir design system with Outfit/DM Sans fonts, noir color palette, and dark amber accents. Added motion.dev animations to all 8 components including whileHover/whileTap, AnimatePresence for modals/lists, layout animations, and spring physics. Used black text on amber elements for contrast.

Updated all 4 widget modals with consistent input styling (bg-white/[0.06], border-white/10, amber focus rings). Added Cancel buttons with secondary variant. Standardized form spacing to space-y-5. Fixed date input dark mode with [color-scheme:dark].

entries.task: Manual city entry for Weather Widget
entries.approach: Used existing Modal component with React Portal. Integrated Open-Meteo geocoding API with debounced search (300ms). Stored selected city in localStorage. Fixed modal flickering by using createPortal to render at document.body level.

entries.task: Add missing PATCH /toggle endpoint for task completion
entries.approach: Added PATCH /:id/toggle endpoint to server/src/routes/tasks.ts. The endpoint fetches the task, toggles its completed status, saves to SQLite, and returns the updated task.
patterns: Express PATCH routes for toggle operations

entries.task: Make InsightsWidget update reactively when tasks change
entries.approach: Used custom events (window.dispatchEvent/addEventListener) for cross-component communication. TasksWidget emits 'tasks-updated' event after add/toggle/delete operations. InsightsWidget listens for this event and reloads stats without regenerating AI insights.
patterns: Custom events for React cross-component communication
